title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related STEM field
qualification: Pursuing CS degree, proficiency in C++, C#, Java, or Python
description: As a Software Engineering Intern at Microsoft, you will work alongside full-time engineers to build features, optimize code, and solve complex technical challenges across Microsoft products.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
eligibility: Non-UK citizens applying to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge
qualification: Outstanding academic record, leadership potential, commitment to improving the lives of others
description: Gates Cambridge Scholarships are highly prestigious, full-cost awards for postgraduate study in any subject available at the University of Cambridge.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open to candidates worldwide with valid work authorization in their resident country
qualification: Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, and experience with Vue.js or React
description: Join GitLab as a Remote Junior Frontend Developer to build user-facing features, optimize frontend performance, and contribute to open-source DevOps tools.

title: Associate Product Manager (APM)
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with up to 2 years of relevant product/tech experience
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
description: Google's APM program offers early-career talent direct hands-on experience guiding product strategy, design, and execution across major Google products.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school or higher education institution
salary: Up to $100,000 USD grand prize + Azure credits
qualification: Build an innovative tech solution addressing real-world issues using Microsoft Azure AI
description: The Imagine Cup is Microsoft's premier global competition for student developers, tech enthusiasts, and young entrepreneurs using technology to create impact.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to students and professionals worldwide without prerequisites
description: An entry-level course taught by David J. Malan, covering algorithmic thinking, C, Python, SQL, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and fundamentals of web development.
